title: fix: select Bluetooth LE devices and symlinked paths again (#20)
body:
- sysinfo.is_virtual treated every node under /sys/devices/virtual as
  virtual, which includes BlueZ's uhid devices (Bluetooth LE / HoG
  keyboards and remotes), so auto-discovery skipped them.
- devices / enabled_devices only matched the literal eventN path; a
  path selector is now also compared after resolving symlinks, so udev
  links like /dev/input/rc or /dev/input/by-id/... work.
- README and compose.yaml warn that the c 13:* rw cgroup rule plus the
  default selection grabs the host's console keyboard.
